title: RFC 4180 CSV record parser
prompt: Write a function csv_parse_line(line) that parses one CSV record into a list of field strings. Fields are separated by commas. A field may be quoted with double quotes, but only when the quote is the first character of the field. Inside a quoted field a doubled quote ("") represents one literal quote and commas are literal. A line with no commas yields a single field. No newline or multi-line handling is required.
